def evolved_grad_ar(rep_grads, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                    cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """Average replicated 1D grads via a single fused all_reduce.

    out[k] = mean over ranks of rep_grads[k].
    Tensors are 1D, so concat directly (no reshape) and split back
    with torch.split (one op) to keep local op count minimal.
    """
    if not rep_grads:
        return rep_grads
    inv = 1.0 / world_size
    sizes = [g.numel() for g in rep_grads]
    flat = torch.cat(rep_grads)
    flat = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, flat) * inv
    return list(torch.split(flat, sizes))
